6232.title: Long project labels can obscure mobile footer controls
6232.rootCauseOneLine: In the reproduced new-thread footer, the non-shrinking project fills its flex group and pushes Environment underneath Agent; the reported existing-thread iOS path remains unverified.
6232.proposedFix: Reserve width for sibling controls and make the project shrink within its real flex budget; reproduce the exact existing-thread iOS path before an issue-closing change.
6232.caveats: Two clean trusted-main runs confirm the adjacent new-thread layout failure, not the exact GitHub-prefixed existing-thread path or native iOS keyboard. No production PR is safe on this evidence.
